_comment: FloodGuard data-freshness policy. Edit this file to retune how quickly each reading type is considered stale/expired — no code changes required, just restart the server (same reload rule as config/zonePolicy.json and config/coverage.json). This generalizes the age check the Zone Engine already does for water-level readings (see config/zonePolicy.json's water_level_rise_adjustment.max_data_age_minutes) into one shared policy every module can read from utils/freshness.js. 'stale_after_minutes' is when a badge first turns amber; 'expired_after_minutes' is when it turns red and the reading should no longer be trusted as current. These are prototype placeholder numbers, not validated operational thresholds — see FINAL FloodGuard sign-off process before any operational use.
